gateway_ip_help: IP address of the Busch-Jaeger Welcome IP Gateway in your local network
gateway_port_help: Port of the gateway (default: 80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)
username_help: Login username for the gateway (from MyBuildings portal or local admin)
sip_port_help: Local UDP port for listening to SIP INVITE packets (default: 5060, alternative: 5065)
poll_interval_help: Interval for health checks and connection status updates
door_open_duration_help: Time in seconds after which the 'ring' state automatically resets to false
